title: An invented cohort: scorecards, a programme, a city's finances and land value capture
about: An invented cohort of three cities (Ardel, Brisa, Corvo) with a resilience scorecard scored with its evidence (Ardel by two assessors), a programme of learning that took their weaknesses as needs (a diagnostic workshop, a peer exchange, a study visit, advisory support), its action plans, results and contribution claims, Ardel's accounts for three years with its loans, and a tram line through its eastern districts with what it could take back from the land it raises and a land readjustment; then the local government sector of a European country from Eurostat. Every city, score, result, account, threshold and rate in the cohort is invented to show the tools; Eurostat's data are real, reused with the source acknowledged.
